recordLocatorConvention: JSON Pointers; array indexes are zero-based because duplicate IDs cannot uniquely identify records.

preservation.policy: Preserve all supplied IDs, fields, values, ordering, and records. Do not merge duplicates or infer missing bibliographic data.
preservation.normalizationDelivery: Supported canonical DOI representations are provided separately below; original DOI values remain untouched.

missingReferences.finding: No bibliography record has this ID; both the citation-list reference and Figure 1 credit are unresolved.

uncitedEntries.finding: This ID occurs in neither the citations array nor the supplied figure credits and is not marked furtherReading.

furtherReadingExemptions.reason: furtherReading is explicitly true; absence from citations is intentional under the supplied flag, not an uncited-entry error.

duplicateIds.finding: The same stable ID identifies Follow-up Survey and Follow-up Survey: Revised Edition. The latter supplies year 2026; the former supplies no year.
duplicateIds.disposition: Retain both records and the original ID values. Do not merge distinct edition metadata or decide which record the citation means.

duplicateSources.difference: R1 supplies a URL; R3 has no URL field.
duplicateSources.finding: High-confidence metadata duplicate: the supplied author, year, title, and DOI are identical. This is not a byte-identical record pair.
duplicateSources.disposition: Flag without consolidating, changing IDs, transferring fields, or replacing R3 usage with R1.

malformedIdentifiers.disposition: Retain the supplied value as evidence and flag it. No replacement DOI can be inferred.

ambiguousMatches.finding: An ID-only citation cannot choose between the original-title record and the revised-edition record.
ambiguousMatches.resolution: unresolved; requires the intended source or citation context

metadataWarnings.finding: No year is supplied for Follow-up Survey. Do not copy 2026 from the revised-edition record.
Only the ID, title, and furtherReading flag are supplied. No DOI, URL, or other retrieval locator is supplied, so the source cannot be identified from this record alone.

The citation style and source types are not specified. These are metadata-completeness warnings, not claims that every omitted optional field is mandatory. Publisher, page/section locators, and any style-required accessed dates cannot be checked or invented.
Ownership, license, permission, and full attribution wording are not supplied. A resolving citation alone cannot establish that a credit or rights status is correct.

supportedNormalizations.basis: Supplied identifier passes local DOI syntax check; prefix with the DOI resolver URL without changing identifier content.
Supplied identifier passes local DOI syntax check; prefix with the DOI resolver URL without changing identifier content.

snapshotValidator.exitInterpretation: Completed and reported findings, not a clean reference audit.
snapshotValidator.coverageLimit: Does not detect same-source records under different IDs, inspect figure credits, check network links, verify truth/rights, or resolve the duplicate R2 edition ambiguity.

supplementaryChecks: Parsed the source JSON and counted supplied records.
Checked three supplied URLs with the local URL parser; syntax only.
Checked three supplied DOI fields locally; two pass syntax, one fails.
Compared R1/R3 source metadata and inspected R2 candidate edition records.
Matched the supplied figure-credit IDs against bibliography IDs.
validationPerformed.citationAuditSchemaValidation: not_performed; no citation-audit schema was specified or loaded

cannotVerify: Whether the supplied sources exist, their metadata are authoritative, or any source supports a factual claim; source documents and manuscript claims were not supplied.
DOI registration, resolution, destination, or correspondence to the named work; local syntax is not registration verification.
URL availability, HTTP status, redirects, content, or authenticity; no network requests were made.
Which R2 edition the citation intends, or missing years/authors/locators without additional source evidence.
Figure ownership, copyright, licenses, permissions, and full credit correctness; no images or rights evidence were supplied.
Uncited factual claims elsewhere in the publication, chart/table source coverage, or bibliography usage outside the supplied citation/credit lists; no publication body was supplied.
Rendered source-line legibility, placement of credits, and publication numbering sequence; no renders or citation-style specification were supplied. R-prefixed stable IDs have not been renumbered.
